changes.comment: Add opt-in `loadPaths` and `resolveBareSpecifiersAsPackages` options, which allow a bare specifier such as `@use '@scope/pkg/theme'` to be resolved from a load path or as a package when it does not resolve relative to the importing file. Both are disabled by default, preserving the specification behavior in which such a specifier is a relative URL.

Apply the legacy `~` to `pkg:` rewrite during canonicalization, so that it also works in constructs other than `@use`/`@import`/`@forward`, such as `meta.load-css()`. Previously these threw an `Unexpected tilde in URL` error.
